apt_file_main_config.description: Path to the main apt-file configuration file, relative to Dir::Etc.

apt_file_index_names.description:
Comma-separated list of index name types to search by default (e.g., 'deb', 'udeb', 'source').
      "enum": [
        "deb",
        "dsc",
        "udeb",
        "ALL"
      ],
      "enum_open": true
    } as a single string value in the config file. Valid comma-separated values are deb, dsc, udeb, ALL. If enum_open is true, any custom comma-separated combination is allowed.

apt_file_parser_check_description_header.description: Whether to expect and validate a description header in Contents files (set to 'true' for older dak/reprepro output). Valid values are 'true' or 'false'.
